# BBRI.JK — house coverage rates it BUY

Signal: the South Research division published coverage (v2) with a 12-month target of Rp4,010.0 against Rp2,710.0 (expected total return 62.0%). Why now: the rating crossed the BUY band on the engine's probability-weighted target.

Archetype guess: quality_bank_rerating · method card: per fund record routing for Banks.

Sharpest questions for a thesis:
- The post-balance-sheet review is dated to the 30 June 2026 balance sheet and cites only the August monthly LK and the May dividend, while the update is occasioned by the 30 September 2026 LK: total assets Rp2,337.60tn, c
- The bear shocks credit cost plus 205bp, loan growth -3pp, deposit growth -3pp and payout +2pp, but never NIM or CASA. The LK shows NIM 6.16% versus 6.53% a year earlier and the deck shows loan yield -83bp with CoF -69bp 
- The payout falls 20pp to 70% although the stated justification shows a constant 92% payout reaching CAR 15.9% by FY2030E on base growth, above the 14.7% floor the company reports [S4 p24]; only the bull's 13% growth brea

Regime stance vs the macro desk is UNASSESSED: IDEATION/CONSTRUCT sets WITH / NEUTRAL / AGAINST before any deep-dive. Fast-disqualify checks and the thesis itself follow the full analyst -> Bear -> Judge law.
